name: Multivariate Transfer Function Design based on User-Selected Samples
aliases: KDE-based Multivariate TF from Spatial Samples
definition: A TF design approach based on user-selected samples from the spatial domain represented as slices for more intuitive exploration of multivariate volume datasets.
summary: This method automates high-dimensional transfer function generation from user-selected spatial samples using Kernel Density Estimation, bridging spatial and transfer function domains without manual parameter tuning.
